```{r}
#| include: false
# Quarto dashboard option: R runs once at render time and produces a static
# page. Interactive parts are plotly widgets (made in R) and Observable JS
# cells (run in the browser). There is no R server.
source("R/_load_all.R")
library(plotly)
A <- readRDS("results/app_data.rds")
P <- A$p
fmt_p <- function(x) sprintf("%.2f%%", 100 * x)
pl <- function(p) config(p, displaylogo = FALSE)
```

## Row

```{r}
#| title: Annual failure probability by grade (log scale; CF = worst case)
d <- A$long
plot_ly(d, x = ~rating, y = ~p_fail, color = ~asset_group, type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
        text = ~paste(asset_group, rating, fmt_p(p_fail)), hoverinfo = "text") |>
  layout(yaxis = list(type = "log", title = "P(fail)"), xaxis = list(title = ""), showlegend = FALSE) |> pl()
```

```{r}
#| title: "Change in P(fail) per notch of grade error (%)"
e <- A$elasticity
z <- tapply(e$pct_per_notch, list(e$asset_group, e$grade), identity)
plot_ly(x = A$grades, y = rownames(z), z = z, type = "heatmap", colorscale = "YlOrRd", reversescale = TRUE,
        hovertemplate = "%{y} %{x}: %{z:.0f}%<extra></extra>") |>
  layout(yaxis = list(autorange = "reversed", title = ""), xaxis = list(title = "")) |> pl()
```

# Multi-year risk

```{r}
# Hand the probability table to Observable JS
ojs_define(ptab = data.frame(group = A$long$asset_group, rating = as.character(A$long$rating),
                             idx = A$long$rating_index, p = A$long$p_fail)[!A$long$is_cf, ],
           grades = A$grades)
```

## Inputs {.sidebar}

```{ojs}
viewof groupSel = Inputs.select([...new Set(transpose(ptab).map(d => d.group))].sort(),
  {label: "Asset groups", multiple: 6, value: ["Electrical A", "Concrete A"]})
viewof startGrade = Inputs.select(grades, {label: "Starting grade", value: "C"})
viewof horizon = Inputs.range([1, 50], {label: "Horizon (years)", step: 1, value: 20})
viewof q = Inputs.range([0, 0.5], {label: "q: annual prob. of dropping a notch", step: 0.01, value: 0.2})
```

This calculator runs in your browser with Observable JS. It uses the same Markov
model as the R function `multiyear_risk()`. Each year the asset fails with the
annual P(fail) of its current grade. Survivors then drop one notch with
probability *q*, stopping at F-. q = 0 means the grade does not change.

## Results

```{ojs}
rows = transpose(ptab)
curve = g => grades.map(gr => rows.find(r => r.group === g && r.rating === gr).p)

function markov(p, g0, T, q) {
  const n = p.length; let alive = new Array(n).fill(0); alive[g0] = 1;
  const out = [];
  for (let t = 1; t <= T; t++) {
    const a = alive.map((v, i) => v * (1 - p[i]));
    const nxt = new Array(n).fill(0);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      if (i < n - 1) { nxt[i] += a[i] * (1 - q); nxt[i + 1] += a[i] * q; } else nxt[i] += a[i];
    }
    alive = nxt;
    out.push({year: t, cumulative: 1 - alive.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0)});
  }
  return out;
}

series = groupSel.flatMap(g => [
  ...markov(curve(g), grades.indexOf(startGrade), horizon, q).map(d => ({...d, group: g, scenario: `q = ${q}`})),
  ...markov(curve(g), grades.indexOf(startGrade), horizon, 0).map(d => ({...d, group: g, scenario: "no deterioration"}))
])

Plot.plot({
  grid: true, color: {legend: true},
  x: {label: "Year"}, y: {label: "P(failed by year t)", domain: [0, 1]},
  marks: [
    Plot.line(series, {x: "year", y: "cumulative", stroke: "group",
                       strokeDasharray: d => d.scenario === "no deterioration" ? "4,4" : null}),
    Plot.tip(series, Plot.pointerX({x: "year", y: "cumulative",
             title: d => `${d.group} (${d.scenario})\nyear ${d.year}: ${(100*d.cumulative).toFixed(1)}%`}))
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
Inputs.table(groupSel.map(g => {
  const s = markov(curve(g), grades.indexOf(startGrade), horizon, q);
  const s0 = markov(curve(g), grades.indexOf(startGrade), horizon, 0);
  return {group: g, [`P(fail) in ${horizon} yrs, q = ${q}`]: s.at(-1).cumulative,
          [`… no deterioration`]: s0.at(-1).cumulative};
}), {format: {[`P(fail) in ${horizon} yrs, q = ${q}`]: x => (100*x).toFixed(2) + "%",
              [`… no deterioration`]: x => (100*x).toFixed(2) + "%"}})
```

# Global sensitivity

## Row {.tabset}

```{r}
#| title: "Mean total-order index Tᵢ by group (annual)"
i <- A$l2_influence[A$l2_influence$horizon == 1, ]
z <- tapply(i$Ti, list(i$asset_group, i$parameter), mean)
plot_ly(x = colnames(z), y = rownames(z), z = z, type = "heatmap", colorscale = "Viridis",
        hovertemplate = "%{y}, %{x}: %{z:.2f}<extra></extra>") |>
  layout(yaxis = list(autorange = "reversed", title = ""), xaxis = list(title = "")) |> pl()
```

```{r}
#| title: "Tᵢ across observed grades (median over groups)"
m <- aggregate(Ti ~ grade + parameter + horizon, A$l2_influence, median)
m$horizon <- ifelse(m$horizon == 1, "annual", "10-year")
plot_ly(m, x = ~grade, y = ~Ti, color = ~paste(parameter, "·", horizon), type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers") |>
  layout(yaxis = list(title = "median Tᵢ"), xaxis = list(title = "Observed grade")) |> pl()
```

```{r}
#| title: "Structure comparison: % non-influential inputs"
en <- A$ensemble
en$h <- ifelse(en$horizon == 1, "annual", "10-year")
plot_ly(en, x = ~structure, y = ~pct_noninfluential, color = ~h, type = "box") |>
  layout(boxmode = "group", yaxis = list(title = "% non-influential"), xaxis = list(title = "")) |> pl()
```

## Row {height=25%}

::: {.card title="About these results"}
Sobol' indices are estimated with `sensobol` (Saltelli first-order, Jansen
total-order). An input is non-influential if both its Sᵢ and Tᵢ confidence
intervals overlap those of a dummy parameter. Every iteration count is capped at
**`r A$settings$iter_cap`**, so the intervals are wide and none reach the 0.05
convergence target. Read "non-influential" as "not shown to be influential at
this sample size".
:::
